headline: Discussed plans for a public forum on short-term rental policy and enforcement practices
summary: The committee reviewed edits to a presentation outline for the upcoming public forum on short-term rental policy, including definitions, a slide on the committee's formation, and a possible public feedback form. Members also discussed how the Health, Building and Fire Departments enforce lodging house licensing rules. The next meeting, the Public Forum, was scheduled for April 8, 2026 at 6pm.
